audit.whatIsWrong: diffRating 8.5/10 and diff EVEN with a red tone told the player this is a hard lane while the win rate is 49.49% over 887 games and the packet chart gives Illaoi six of seven stages.
audit.why: A near-even lane rated 8.5/10 makes the player play scared and give up the early window they actually own. Difficulty moved to 6/10 (Fiora still carries 10/10, which is the real threat) and the tone recoloured to match the EVEN label.
audit.corrected: Difficulty 6/10, tone recoloured to the even swatch, and breakdown.difficulty plus report[14] restated to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: win[] and phases[].side gave Fiora levels 1, 2, 3, 6 and two-plus items, contradicting the packet chart and the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: The mirror settled the chart as Skill / Illaoi / Illaoi / Skill / Illaoi / Illaoi / Skill. Both layers hold the same row, so the flips are proposed as one atomic pair-set with the ratings rescaled to the Illaoi side.
audit.corrected: Skill / Illaoi / Illaoi / Skill / Illaoi / Illaoi / Skill in both layers; ratings 5/6/7/5/6/6/5; row text rewritten around Lunge's 13s rank-1 cooldown, Riposte's 24s rank-1 cooldown, Leap of Faith's tentacle-per-champion spawn and Grand Challenge's 110s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three places (breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t) said Riposte 'parries your slam + stuns'. Riposte only stuns if it blocked an immobilizing effect, and Illaoi applies none — Test of Spirit slows, Harsh Lesson is a leap, Leap of Faith damages. winCon also asserted 'E her grounded', a grounding effect Riot's Leap of Faith text does not describe.
audit.why: Riot's Riposte text: parries all incoming damage, then a stab that slows the first champion hit, or stuns them if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect. Telling the player to expect a stun makes them refuse fights they win. The kit generator flags Leap of Faith with 'grounding' and 'untargetable' while Riot's description mentions neither, so per calibration nothing was asserted about either.
audit.corrected: Riposte restated as a full damage parry whose return stab only slows in this matchup, with its 24/22/20/18/16s cooldown named; 'E her grounded' replaced with fighting inside the tentacle field; Grand Challenge's true damage flagged against armour stacking (missingInteractions: resistances-invalidated), and Lunge's on-hit application left as the reason armour alone misreads the trade.

audit.whatIsWrong: Riposte was named as the tracked cooldown everywhere but never numbered, and Lunge and Grand Challenge were never numbered at all.
audit.why: Riposte is 24s at rank 1 and Lunge 13s at rank 1 — both enormous windows the player can count. Grand Challenge is 110s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into phases[0].why, phases[1].why, phases[4].why, whys[0], whys[3], breakdown.cooldowns, winCon and breakdown.difficulty.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fiora was referred to as 'he'/'his' in tradeGood, breakdown.trading, report[3], dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[0].d, breakdown.wave, report[4], breakdown.feeding, report[12], breakdown.late, report[8] and phases[1].why.
audit.why: Wrong-pronoun boilerplate reads as untouched template text and undercuts trust in the rest of the page.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected in place at identical length.
